name: ISO/IEC 42001
description: Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) controls covering AI governance, impact assessments, data lineage, model lifecycle, and human oversight. Short original summaries.

requirements.title: AI policy and internal organization
requirements.summary: Approved AI governance policies and accountable owners across model lifecycles.

children.title: AI acceptable use and governance policy
children.summary: Written policy defines permitted AI use cases, risk tolerances, and review gates.

children.title: AI roles and oversight responsibilities
children.summary: Named owners oversee AI model approvals, monitoring, and escalation.

requirements.title: AI resources and impact assessment
requirements.summary: Inventory of AI systems, datasets, and documented societal and privacy impact reviews.

children.title: Inventory of AI systems and models
children.summary: Production models, prompts, and third-party AI APIs are cataloged with owners.

children.title: AI system impact assessment
children.summary: High-impact AI features undergo documented safety, fairness, and privacy assessments.

requirements.title: AI lifecycle and training data governance
requirements.summary: Controlled releases, model testing, data provenance, and privacy controls.

children.title: Controlled AI development and deployment
children.summary: Model updates and prompt changes pass documented peer review and testing before release.

children.title: Data quality and privacy for AI
children.summary: Datasets exclude unauthorized PII and enforce retention and encryption rules.

requirements.title: Transparency, human oversight, and third-party AI
requirements.summary: Clear user disclosure, human-in-the-loop review, and foundation-model vendor due diligence.

children.title: Transparency and citation logging
children.summary: AI-assisted outputs identify their basis and log user-visible citations.

children.title: Human oversight and override controls
children.summary: Qualified staff review and approve AI-generated compliance or customer outputs.

children.title: Third-party AI supplier review
children.summary: External LLM and AI vendors undergo security, training-opt-out, and data-residency reviews.
